ADDENDUM (Rules on University Tuition and Admission Fees) <No. 16, September 29, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) and (2) Omitted.

(3) Part of the Rules on Emeritus Professors shall be amended as follows:

In Article 2, "broadcasting universities, correspondence universities, and open universities" shall be replaced with "broadcasting universities, correspondence universities, open universities, and cyber universities".

(4) Omitted.
